title: 약속 거절하기: 안 가요? 못 가요?
objective: By the end, you can make negative sentences with 안 (I don't / choose not to) and 못 (I can't / something stops me) and choose the right one for the situation. You can also put 안/못 in the right place with noun + 하다 verbs, use only 안 with adjectives, and say 못 먹어요 as [몬머거요].
summary: Learn when to say 안 (don't / choose not to) and when to say 못 (can't), and where to put each one in a sentence.

task.title: CHOOSE AND USE 안 OR 못
task.line: Read each situation, then choose, write, or say the right negative form.

forms.when: You choose not to do something, or you simply say 'not'.
forms.means: don't / not (your choice or a plain fact)
forms.exampleMeaning: I don't eat breakfast. (I skip it.)

forms.when: You want to, but something stops you: no time, no money, sickness, rules.
forms.exampleMeaning: I had too much work, so I couldn't eat lunch.

forms.when: With noun + 하다 verbs (공부하다, 운동하다), put 안/못 right before 해요. You can also add 을/를: 운동을 못 해요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm busy these days, so I can't work out.

forms.when: Adjectives (비싸다, 크다, 춥다) describe things. Nobody 'tries' to be expensive, so use only 안.
When the next word starts with ㅁ or ㄴ, 못 sounds like [몬]. Also, a final consonant moves to a following vowel: 먹어요 → [머거요], 놀아요 → [노라요].
forms.exampleMeaning: I can't eat spicy food. (못 먹어요 sounds like [몬머거요].)

watchOut: 안 공부해요 (X) → 공부 안 해요 (O): With noun + 하다 verbs, 안/못 goes right before 해요.
못 비싸요 (X) → 안 비싸요 (O): Adjectives take 안, never 못.
좋아 안 해요 (X) → 안 좋아해요 (O): 좋아하다 is one verb, not noun + 하다, so 안 goes in front.
안 가요 vs 못 가요: Both 아파서 학교에 안 가요 and 아파서 학교에 못 가요 are correct. If being sick stops you from going, 못 가요 is more natural. 안 가요 sounds like you decided not to go.
[못머거요] (X) → [몬머거요] (O): Before ㅁ or ㄴ, say 못 as [몬].
exercises: Choose 안 or 못: ①축구를 정말 좋아해요. 그런데 다리가 부러졌어요. 그래서 축구를 (안 / 못) 해요. ②오늘은 배가 안 고파요. 그래서 저녁을 (안 / 못) 먹어요. ③지갑을 집에 두고 왔어요. 그래서 커피를 (안 / 못) 사요.
Put the words in the right order to make a sentence: 해요 / 청소 / 오늘은 / 안
Each sentence has one mistake. Rewrite it correctly: ①제 방은 못 넓어요. ②동생이 안 운전해요.
Write how 못 + the verb sounds, in Hangul: ①저는 우유를 못 마셔요. (못 마셔요) ②숙제가 많아서 못 놀아요. (못 놀아요)
You want to go to the party, but you have to work. Complete your answer: 친구: 내일 파티에 와요? / 나: 아니요, 일이 있어서 ____.
Complete your answer with 안 or 못 and 무섭다: 친구: 그 영화 무서워요? / 나: 아니요, 별로 ____.
answers: ① 못 ② 안 ③ 못
① 제 방은 안 넓어요. ② 동생이 운전 안 해요. (동생이 운전을 안 해요.)
